conceptZh: 蝦子身體彎彎，有長長的鬚
object: a tiny felt ninja and a stubborn bamboo fishing rod with a pink shrimp
morph: the fishing rod keeps misbehaving until the ninja lands the strokes of 蝦
creativeAngle: 布忍者想釣出字，釣竿不聽話，最後釣到一隻粉紅蝦。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip teaching the Traditional Chinese character 蝦 (shrimp). Lead: a small black felt ninja with a floppy mask, certain nobody can see him even when he stands in the open. Moment 1 (0-1.7s): he tiptoes up and hides behind a thin reed, his whole body sticking out; the voice says 蝦 as he casts a bamboo rod that boomerangs and hooks his own hood. Moment 2 (1.7-3.4s): the rod has its own mind, flinging him upward; a pink stroke dangles from the line, then another; on the second 蝦 he finally lands the last stroke and 蝦 appears. Moment 3 (3.4-5.3s): the ninja hides behind the glyph with his feet visible; a big red-orange lobster with giant claws bursts from a bubble and the voice says 龍蝦 as the ninja freezes mid-tiptoe, eyes wide. Moment 4 (5.3-8s): glyph still; the ninja bows silently to the lobster, who waggles its claws. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "蝦、蝦、龍蝦" (ㄒㄧㄚ、ㄒㄧㄚ、ㄌㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄚ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, then stops; no other speech, no music louder than the voice. The only on-screen text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 蝦, drawn as saturated solid rose pink strokes on a pale mint background, correctly formed, centered, filling about 70% of frame height with margins, perfectly still for the final 3-second hold while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. No vocabulary text, subtitles, watermark, clutter, flashing, real people or realistic humans; bright but not neon, no dark grading.
